description: Vet a teammate's HLA answer before it scores. Check every name against the release files yourself, re-read each messy text for misreads, confirm a cut-off list holds every possible current name and nothing else, and that INVALID really was never assigned. decision 'approve' scores it (total only; you gain points when it scores well and lose them when it does not); 'reject' scores nothing.
